releases.name: Mnemory 1.15.2
releases.body:
## Fixed

- Ship compiled JavaScript alongside the OpenClaw plugin sources, lock the build
  dependency, and verify that the packaged runtime loads before npm publication.

## Distribution

- Publish multi-architecture container images to
  `ghcr.io/fpytloun/mnemory`, with source-repository labels and tested tag rules.
- Document GHCR pull/build commands and retain the best-effort deletion warning
  alongside the Cognis introduction.

The OpenClaw plugin remains at its separately published version 0.2.2.
Deletion remains best effort, not a verified-erasure or compliance guarantee.

releases.name: OpenClaw Plugin v0.2.2
releases.body:
Fixes npm installation with recent OpenClaw versions by shipping compiled JavaScript.

Also fixes compatibility of the publishing verification with npm 12. See #16, #17, and #18.

releases.name: OpenClaw Plugin v0.2.1
releases.body:
The npm publication for this release failed; version 0.2.1 was not published to npm. Please use [OpenClaw Plugin v0.2.2](https://github.com/fpytloun/mnemory/releases/tag/openclaw-v0.2.2) instead.

The packaging fix and its follow-up are described in #16, #17, and #18.

releases.name: Mnemory 1.15.1
releases.body:
Fixes best-effort online erasure of retracted lineages, including older revision IDs; preserves ordinary retraction/history and sequential shared artifacts. Object-storage cleanup errors are reported, and stale retraction recovery does not recreate missing journals. Includes maintenance reliability improvements and portable examples/documentation.

Privacy erasure remains best effort, not transactional or verified permanent erasure. Concurrent writes/recovery, derived sessions, backups, historical object versions and external logs may retain or recreate information. No maintenance-only API restriction, persistence migration or automatic erasure is introduced. See docs/deletion.md.

Qualification: 1,721 passed / 20 skipped including all 80 real-provider E2E tests; supported Python 3.11–3.14 deterministic suites, lint/format/lock/build and independent code/privacy review passed. An earlier timing-sensitive batch-deadline failure is retained in validation evidence; the complete unchanged suite rerun passed. Gitleaks was unavailable; semantic privacy review, targeted scans and package/source checks completed.

releases.name: v1.15.0 — Managed inference
releases.body:
## Added
- Cognis-managed inference routing and service JWT authentication.
- Memory browser creation-time sorting and date-range filters.

## Fixed
- Explicit reasoning effort overrides are preserved; managed inference defaults are inherited when no override is set.

## Validation
Python 3.12: 1,589 non-E2E tests passed, 20 skipped, 80 E2E deselected. Lint, formatting, lockfile and distribution builds passed.
Real-provider E2E was omitted with a one-time release approval. Real inference remains unverified; the Python 3.14 native BM25 stemmer issue has not been verified as fixed.
